arxiv-2202-07211.title: Effect of expanding learning scope on the evolution of cooperation in scale-free networks
arxiv-2202-07211.creator: Masaaki Inaba, Eizo Akiyama
arxiv-2202-07211.description: Abstract We study how expanding the scope for selecting game and learning (adaptation) partners affects the evolution of cooperation in public goods games on scale-free networks. We show the following three results. (i) Expanding the scope for selecting game partners suppresses cooperation. (ii) Expanding the scope for selecting learning partners promotes cooperation when cooperation evolution is difficult.

arxiv-2209-07865.title: Norm inflation and ill-posedness for the Fornberg-Whitham equation
arxiv-2209-07865.creator: Jinlu Li, Xing Wu, Yanghai Yu, Weipeng Zhu
arxiv-2209-07865.description: Abstract Abstract: In this paper, we prove that the Cauchy problem for the Fornberg-Whitham equation is not locally well-posed in B^{s}_{p,r}(\mathbb{R}) with (s,p,r)\in(1,1+\frac{1}{p})\times[2,\infty)\times[1,\infty] or (s,p,r)\in\{1\}\times[2,\infty)\times[1,2] by showing norm inflation phenomena of the solution for some special initial data. Keywords: Fornberg-Whitham equation, Norm inflation, ill-posedness, Besov spaces MSC (2010): 35Q53, 35B35 1 Introduction 1.

arxiv-2401-14782.title: On some results related to the Karlsson-Nussbaum conjecture in geodesic spaces
arxiv-2401-14782.creator: Aleksandra Huczek
arxiv-2401-14782.description: Abstract . We show a Wolff-Denjoy type theorem in the case of a one-parameter continuous semigroups of nonexpansive mappings in which there is a compact mapping. Using the notion of attractor we are also able to prove some specific properties directly related to the Karlsson-Nussbaum conjecture. 2020 Mathematics Subject Classification Primary 32H50; Secondary 47H09, 37F44, 51M10, 46T25, 53C23 1.

arxiv-2404-03215.title: When Strings Surprise
arxiv-2404-03215.description: Abstract We argue that on-shell excitations with large negative energies are created rapidly when the string coupling increases with time. This does not indicate an inconsistency in string theory since the negative energy on-shell excitation is always entangled with an on-shell excitation with a positive energy. The total energy of this energy-EPR state vanishes.

arxiv-2409-07562.title: Generalized fluctuation-dissipation relations in confined geometries and concentrated conditions
arxiv-2409-07562.creator: Massimiliano Giona ∗ , Giuseppe Procopio and Chiara Pezzotti
arxiv-2409-07562.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Massimiliano Giona ∗ , Giuseppe Procopio and Chiara Pezzotti. pmc-10738821.title: BARRIERS AND SOCIETAL FACTORS SURROUNDING LONG-STAY RESIDENT DISCHARGE TO THE COMMUNITY IN LOUISIANA
pmc-10738821.creator: Valerie Williams
pmc-10738821.description: The focus of this study is to determine the resident characteristics and societal factors that prevent long-stay residents (LSR) from discharging to the community based on the LSR in Louisiana (LA) compared to the United States (US). This study will also explore solutions that can assist LSR in successfully discharging to the community.

pmc-11450171.title: Developmental and housekeeping transcriptional programs display distinct modes of enhancer-enhancer cooperativity in Drosophila
pmc-11450171.creator: Vincent Loubiere, Bernardo P de Almeida, Michaela Pagani, Alexander Stark
pmc-11450171.description: Genomic enhancers are key transcriptional regulators which, upon the binding of sequence-specific transcription factors, activate their cognate target promoters. Although enhancers have been extensively studied in isolation, a substantial number of genes have more than one simultaneously active enhancer, and it remains unclear how these cooperate to regulate transcription.

pmc-11686053.title: Antibodies Against Phosphorylcholine in Prediction of Cardiovascular Disease Among Women
pmc-11686053.creator: Johan Frostegård, Agneta Åkesson, Emilie Helte, Fredrik Söderlund, Jun Su, Xiang Hua, Susanne Rautiainen, Alicja Wolk
pmc-11686053.description: BackgroundAntibodies against phosphorylcholine (anti-PC) have been reported as associated with protection against atherosclerosis, cardiovascular disease (CVD), and other chronic inflammatory diseases. Underlying potential mechanisms have been demonstrated and include anti-inflammatory, clearance of dead cells, and inhibition of oxidized low-density lipoprotein effects.

pmc-12512717.title: Interactions between gut microbiota and parkinson’s disease: the role of tryptophan metabolism
pmc-12512717.creator: Xuemei Fan, Zhaoqun Xiao, Yan Chen, Hui Yang, Mengyuan Diao, Wei Hu, Shuai Wang
pmc-12512717.description: Parkinson’s disease, a common neurodegenerative disorder in the elderly, is characterized by motor symptoms and non-motor symptoms such as anxiety, depression, sleep disturbances, and gastrointestinal dysfunction, highlighting its nature as a multisystem disease. The critical role of the microbiota-gut-brain axis in maintaining human homeostasis is well established, and growing evidence links its dysfunction and gut microbiota dysbiosis to Parkinson’s disease.

pmc-12656781.title: Hepatitis C Direct-Acting Antivirals in the Immunosuppressed Host: Mechanisms, Interactions, and Clinical Outcomes
pmc-12656781.creator: Hoor AlKaabi, Siham AlSinani, Mohamed El-Kassas, Khalid A. Alswat, Khalid M. AlNaamani
pmc-12656781.description: Direct-acting antivirals (DAAs) have transformed hepatitis C virus (HCV) management, offering high cure rates, favorable safety, and simplified regimens. Management in immunosuppressed patients remains challenging due to drug–drug interactions (DDIs). The objective of this review is to summarize clinical outcomes, safety, and pharmacologic considerations of DAA therapy in immunosuppressed patients, including solid organ transplant recipients and those on biological agents.

pmc-12698422.title: Meta-analysis on the safety and efficacy of long-term garlic consumption as an adjunctive treatment for hypertension
pmc-12698422.creator: Yiyue Tang, Yunzhen Lei, Ming Xu, Qingxian Tu, Xiaochun Mao, Nanqu Huang, Qianfeng Jiang
pmc-12698422.description: ObjectivesThis systematic review and meta-analysis aimed to synthesize existing evidence, quantify the overall effect of garlic intervention on blood pressure, and explore potential variations in its effects under different population, formulation, and intervention duration conditions. This provides scientific evidence to support the clinical application of garlic in non-pharmacological interventions for hypertension.

pmc-13179351.title: Quality of TikTok videos on sudden cardiac death varies by video characteristics and health information accuracy
pmc-13179351.creator: Mitansh Bansal, Ayesha Jalal, Firdous M. Usman, Sadhana Sureshkumar, Meisya Rosamystica, Vikas Bansal, Faisal A. Nawaz, Rahul Kashyap
pmc-13179351.description: Social media platforms like TikTok have become a source of health information, particularly for younger audiences, but concerns remain about the accuracy and reliability of this content. This study assessed the quality, engagement, and sentiment of TikTok videos on sudden cardiac death (SCD), comparing healthcare professional (HCP) and non-HCP creators.

pmc-13382597.title: High frequency edge network for accurate cardiac structure segmentation
pmc-13382597.creator: Shuai He, Hui Xiong, Wenmiao Wang, Jiaxin Zhang, Min Zhu, Haijian Guo, Wei Qin
pmc-13382597.description: SummaryAccurate cardiac structure segmentation is intrinsically a boundary delineation problem, where discriminative anatomical cues are largely encoded in high frequency components. We develop High Frequency Edge Network (HF-EdgeNet), a high frequency driven encoder decoder framework that incorporates structural cues throughout cardiac magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) segmentation.

pmc-13409063.title: A Coupled Model of Acid Transport, Gel Cleanup, and Fracture Propagation in Prepad Acid Fracturing
pmc-13409063.creator: Weiyou Zhang, Yongpeng Sun, Xianghua Meng, Rutong Dou
pmc-13409063.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). In conventional hydraulic fracturing of low-permeability sandstone reservoirs, polymer-gel leak-off creates low-permeability filter cakes that impair productivity. This study proposes a prepad acid fracturing technique using a fluoroboric acid (HBF4) pre-flush to dissolve gel residues and mineral fines. A fully coupled mathematical model integrates HBF4 hydrolysis kinetics, multi-mineral surface reactions, porosity-permeability evolution via the Panda–Lake model, and dynamic leak-off coefficient feedback. Simulations show HBF4 decreases monotonically along the fracture while HF peaks at 40–60 m from wellbore.

pmc-13430144.description: IntroductionSelf-regulation plays a pivotal role in development, contributing to overall health and success. pmc-13435455.title: The role of health financing system and pluralism in achieving sustainable development goal health outcomes in India: a multilevel analysis
pmc-13435455.creator: Pragyan Monalisa Sahoo, Himanshu Sekhar Rout
pmc-13435455.description: IntroductionThe health system in India is pluralistic, with different sources of financing and multiple, overlapping financing systems across states. Existing studies often neglect system-specific factors such as fragmented health insurance schemes and state-level financing mechanisms. This study examines how health insurance pluralism, financing systems, and contextual state factors influence SDG health outcomes, integrating both individual and structural dimensions.

uslaw-usc-t42-s11434a.title: 42 U.S.C. § 11434a — Definitions
uslaw-usc-t42-s11434a.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t42-s11434a.description: United States Code, Title 42 (The Public Health And Welfare); Chapter 119 (Homeless Assistance); Subchapter VI (Education And Training); Part B (Education For Homeless Children And Youths). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. For purposes of this part: (1) The terms “enroll” and “enrollment” include attending classes and participating fully in school activities. (2) The term “homeless children and youths”— (A) means individuals.
